class.name: Awakened Necromancer Class
lore: Choose the Awakened Necromancer Class
class.desc_es: Un nigromante con una guadaña espectral: recoge las almas de los caídos y las usa para invocar guerreros, magos y caballeros esqueleto que luchan a su lado.

skills.name: Deathbound Souls
lore: A spectral scythe floats beside you, constantly harvesting the
essence of the fallen.
When enemies die within 30 blocks, they leave behind a Soul.
You can absorb and store up to 5 Souls, allowing you to summon
undead servants anytime, anywhere.
Your summoned army can consist of up to 10 undead minions,
including a maximum of 2 Necroknights.
skills.desc_es: Pasiva: una guadaña espectral flota a tu lado; los enemigos que mueren cerca dejan un alma (guardas hasta 5) para invocar a tu ejército (hasta 10 esbirros, 2 de ellos caballeros).

skills.name: Necrotic Combo
lore: Unleash a chain of sweeping scythe strikes infused with necrotic energy.
1st Strike: A horizontal scythe sweep from left to right.
2nd Strike: A follow-up horizontal slash from right to left.
3rd Strike: Spin the scythe forward, striking vertically.
4th Strike: Raise the scythe overhead and smash it into the
ground, piercing the surface with its blade, slightly knocking up enemies.
🗡 {damage} Damage
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown
skills.desc_es: Barridos de guadaña de lado a lado, un giro vertical y un golpe al suelo que lanza un poco a los enemigos.

skills.name: Skull Wisps
lore: Launch a haunting skull-shaped wisp of necrotic energy forward.
Upon impact, the wisp explodes with dark energy, damaging enemies
and slightly knocking them back.
🗡 {damage} Damage
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown
skills.desc_es: Lanzas una calavera de energía necrótica que estalla al impactar y empuja a los enemigos.

skills.name: Skeletal Warrior
lore: Consume 1 Soul to summon a Skeletal Warrior to fight at your side.
Skeletal Warrior (Melee Minion)
Bone Slash: A quick horizontal sword strike.
Cleave Down: A heavy downward slash aimed at enemies in front.
🗡 {damage} Damage
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown
skills.desc_es: Gastas 1 alma para invocar un guerrero esqueleto que lucha a tu lado con su espada.

skills.name: Necromancer's Command
lore: Switch summon modes between Focus, Free, and Idle mode.
Focus Mode: Your minions attack only the enemy you last
dealt damage to.
Free Mode: Your minions attack random enemies, excluding
party/guild members.
Idle Mode: Your minions don't attack enemies and only follow you.
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown
skills.desc_es: Cambia el modo de tus esbirros: Foco (al último enemigo que golpeaste), Libre (a cualquier enemigo) o Quieto (solo te siguen).

skills.name: Skeletal Mage
lore: Consume 1 Soul to summon a Skeletal Mage that attacks enemies from range.
Skeletal Mage (Ranged Minion)
Necroball: Fires a burning orb of soul energy that applies
Necrotic Burn, dealing damage over time.
🗡 {damage} Damage
🔥 {burndamage} Burn Damage
🕗 {burnduration}s Burn Duration
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown
skills.desc_es: Gastas 1 alma para invocar un mago esqueleto que ataca de lejos con orbes que queman.

skills.name: Necroknight
lore: Consume 1 Soul to summon a powerful Necroknight, an elite undead
warrior clad in cursed armor mounting an undead horse.
Necroknight (Melee Minion)
Lance Thrust: A long-reaching lance strike that deals high
damage and knocks enemies back.
Lance Charge: Charges forward aggressively while striking
repeatedly with the lance.
🗡 {damage} Damage
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown
skills.desc_es: Gastas 1 alma para invocar un caballero no muerto a lomos de un caballo esqueleto que ataca con su lanza y carga contra los enemigos.
